title: Court Clears the Way for Iowa Ammunition Detonation; Trump Addresses the Crisis
summary: The announcement late Monday capped a day of uncertainty in which President Trump spoke out on a crisis that threatens to launch a cloud of toxic lead dust across homes and farmland.
